BRICS economies demand voice in global tax rule negotiations

Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that BRICS economies must have a say in global tax rules as negotiations shape cross-border taxation. The BRICS grouping is increasingly seen as representing emerging and middle powers seeking a greater voice in institutions that shape global affairs and common development priorities.
